title: Mystic Sorceress in Enchanted Library
description: A glowing ethereal woman with flowing white hair and a yellow cape floats in a dark magical forest, reaching toward a glowing book and an oval portrait. In the foreground, a skeleton in a yellow coat sits on a tree stump holding a staff, surrounded by swirling colorful magic, floating books, gears, and an ornate stained glass window in the background.
prompt: A glowing translucent sorceress with long flowing white hair and a bright yellow cape floats gracefully in a dark enchanted forest, reaching her hand toward an open magical book and a glowing oval portrait. In the foreground, a small skeleton wearing a yellow coat sits on a gnarled tree stump holding a staff, surrounded by swirling pink and blue magic, floating books, gears, and roots. An ornate glowing stained glass window illuminates the mystical scene from above.
